messages:
morgan: FYI a customer hit a 415 + garbage scores trying to 'stream' to our /v1/rerank endpoint. They opened a ticket with curl + SSE client. ticket: #T-8421 :eyes:
support-bot: New support ticket created: T-8421 — customer reports rerank streaming attempt failing with 415 and unexpected low scores. Link: https://redwood/support/T-8421
sam: can you paste their exact request? thinking if this is content-type mismatch or a streaming protocol mixup :thinking:
morgan: pasted their curl from the ticket below, verbatim:
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-XXXXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"query":"Which answer is best?","candidates":["A","B","C"]}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank
```
jen: that explains the 415. /v1/rerank expects application/json POST (non-streaming). SSE / text/event-stream isn't supported — we return 415 Unsupported Media Type. the strange scores are from the client retrying in a loop, parsing partial SSE bits as JSON and defaulting to 0.0.
priya: customer says they used our streaming helper in their SDK because they thought rerank "should stream like chat" — they tried to reuse the streaming client. it's a pretty common confusion in app code.
nate: repro locally: sent same curl -> immediately got 415 + response body: `{ "error": "unsupported_content_type", "detail":"use application/json POST to /v1/rerank" }`
sam: can you include a short repro with expected working curl so we can send the customer a fix? also check whether auth or billing contributed — token is fine in the ticket but the customer also hit quota errors earlier.
jen: working example to share:
```
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-XXXXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"Which answer is best?","candidates":["A","B","C"]}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank
```
Response (200): `{"scores":[0.72,0.18,0.10]}` — note: single JSON response, no streaming SSE allowed.
morgan: added repro steps to ticket and flagged as P2. also noted the customer saw repeated low scores because their SSE client was splitting/parsing fragments incorrectly.
sam: do we need a more helpful error message to avoid confusion? maybe detect text/event-stream and return guidance + link to docs instead of generic 415.
jen: we already return unsupported_content_type but can add quick hint: "streaming not supported for rerank — use application/json POST. See: https://docs.redwood.ai/api/rerank". I'll open a small runtime PR.
priya: customer also mentioned they tried streaming to /v1/rerank because embeddings/similarity endpoints stream in their SDK. we should add SDK guardrails (throw if user calls stream on rerank) and docs note. filing SDK issue now.
support-bot: Escalation: assigned to eng-runtime and devex. Tags: rerank, sse, docs.
nate: also verified no auth/billing clues in logs — token validated, no quota denies. only content-type mismatch and malformed parsing caused the noise.
sam: next actions: jen to add clearer error text + runtime PR, priya to add SDK guardrail and docs snippet, morgan to send the customer the working curl + explanation and ask if they'd like a short call.
morgan: will do. sending the customer the working example + note about why their client saw weird scores. :thumbsup:
priya: putting a small doc blurb in the rerank section: "Rerank does NOT support streaming; send full JSON POST. If you need streaming semantics, consider the search/chat endpoints or run custom logic client-side."
sam: thanks team — keep me posted if customer wants an extended SLA or it's a deeper product ask.
morgan: ticket updated, closing internal thread.
